about: S106 0F (docs/research/s106/0F.md). HAND-WRITTEN list of what a run's triage findings may be and still not fail the verdict. One entry per sub-reason token: modes ['*'] or a list of mode ids; class; sub = a regex on ONE sub-reason token (fallback_2d 'kind name', rows_not_drawn / pic_refusals pair name, holes 'family: first text', hole_skip / strikes / technique / reflect reason text, black_no_3d 'mid_match N', no_file_open 'trail after script quit', holes_2d 'no site, within the load-window fallback frames'); verdict normal (by design) | known (open work already lodged: the row id is printed, the verdict reads KNOWN, never PASS) | derived (accepted only up to / together with another class: derived_from + limit count|all_accepted); max = a cap per mode (null = none). A known row leaves this file when its fix lands (the next sweep then FAILs if it did not). Rows R1, R2, R3, R4, R7, R8, R9 of the note are deliberately NOT here (S106 0FF F2: R3 left out too, its row accepted every gpu_picture refusal): they FAIL until fixed. The loader (triage.load_accepted) refuses an entry for a never-acceptable class (problem, load_stall, load_watch, UNPARSED), a holes_2d with a named site, a black_no_3d with mid_match > 0, an idle with no quit line. (S106 0FF F1) Every judged entry has a max: the sum of every token the entry accepted in ONE mode (a distinct text does not escape it), the largest per-mode sum in the 36 final-sweep logs (runs 144-179) x about 3. (S106 0FFN N3) The A1-A4 rows are per mode: one entry per mode the row was seen in over the 36 final-sweep logs, each with ITS OWN max (about 1.4 x the largest per-mode sum observed); a mode the row was never seen in FAILs (a stale row is named only when none of its entries matched).
